# Forage Netherlands

> A free guide to wild food in the Netherlands: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 25 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Brandnetel. In season March to June.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Daslook. In season March to May.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Paardenbloem. In season March to October.
- [Ground elder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/groundelder/): Aegopodium podagraria; Zevenblad. In season March to June.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Vogelmuur. In season March to November.
- [Common sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/sorrel/): Rumex acetosa; Veldzuring. In season April to August.
- [Garlic mustard](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/garlicmustard/): Alliaria petiolata; Look-zonder-look. In season March to June.
- [Fat hen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/fathen/): Chenopodium album; Melganzenvoet. In season May to September.
- [Ribwort plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/plantain/): Plantago lanceolata; Smalle weegbree. In season April to September.
- [Watercress](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/watercress/): Nasturtium officinale; Witte waterkers. In season March to October.

- [Sea beet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/seabeet/): Beta vulgaris subsp. maritima; Strandbiet. In season March to October.
- [Marsh samphire](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/samphire/): Salicornia europaea; Zeekraal. In season June to August.
- [Blue mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/mussel/): Mytilus edulis; Mossel. In season January to December.

- [Blackberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/blackberry/): Rubus fruticosus; Braam. In season August to September.
- [Wild raspberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/raspberry/): Rubus idaeus; Framboos. In season July to August.
- [Bilberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/bilberry/): Vaccinium myrtillus; Blauwe bosbes. In season July to August.

- [Elderberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/elderberry/): Sambucus nigra; Vlierbes. In season August to September.
- [Elderflower](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/elderflower/): Sambucus nigra; Vlierbloesem. In season May to June.
- [Sloe](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/sloe/): Prunus spinosa; Sleedoorn. In season September to November.
- [Rose hips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/rosehip/): Rosa canina; Rozenbottel. In season September to November.
- [Rowan berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/rowan/): Sorbus aucuparia; Lijsterbes. In season August to October.
- [Hawthorn](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/hawthorn/): Crataegus monogyna; Meidoorn. In season September to October.

- [Crowberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/crowberry/): Empetrum nigrum; Kraaihei. In season August to September.
- [Wild blackcurrant](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/blackcurrant/): Ribes nigrum; Zwarte bes. In season July to August.
- [Juniper berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/juniper/): Juniperus communis; Jeneverbes. In season September to November.

- [Yarrow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/yarrow/): Achillea millefolium; Duizendblad. In season June to September.

- [Chanterelle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/chanterelle/): Cantharellus cibarius; Cantharel. In season July to October.
- [Porcini](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/porcini/): Boletus edulis; Eekhoorntjesbrood. In season August to October.
- [Giant puffball](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/puffball/): Calvatia gigantea; Reuzenbovist. In season July to September.
- [Chicken of the woods](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/chickenwoods/): Laetiporus sulphureus; Zwavelzwam. In season May to September.

- [Cleavers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/cleavers/): Galium aparine; Kleefkruid. In season February to May.

- [Water mint](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/watermint/): Mentha aquatica; Watermunt. In season May to September.
- [Wild marjoram](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/marjoram/): Origanum vulgare; Wilde marjolein. In season June to September.
- [Lamb's lettuce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/lambslettuce/): Valerianella locusta; Veldsla. In season January to December.
- [Birch sap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/birchsap/): Betula pendula; Berkensap. In season March to April.
- [Cherry plum](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/cherryplum/): Prunus cerasifera; Kerspruim. In season July to August.
- [Beach rose](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/rugosa/): Rosa rugosa; Rimpelroos. In season August to October.
- [Heather flowers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/heather/): Calluna vulgaris; Struikheide. In season August to September.
- [Bog myrtle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/bogmyrtle/): Myrica gale; Wilde gagel. In season June to September.
- [Scurvy grass](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/plants/scurvygrass/): Cochlearia officinalis; Echt lepelblad. In season March to July.

## Dishes

- [Elderflower syrup (vlierbloesemsiroop)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/elderflower-syrup/): Flower heads steeped with lemon, strained and boiled with sugar.
- [Sea buckthorn juice (duindoornsap)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/sea-buckthorn-juice/): Tart orange berries from the dunes, juiced and sweetened.
- [Rose hip tea (rozenbotteltee)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/rose-hip-tea/): Dried rose hips simmered into a tangy tea.
- [Zeeland mussels (Zeeuwse mosselen)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/zeeland-mussels/): Mussels steamed with celery, onion and white wine, with fries.
- [Fried samphire (zeekraal)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/fried-samphire/): Samphire tossed in butter with garlic.
- [Blackberry jam (bramenjam)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/blackberry-jam/): Blackberries cooked with sugar and lemon.
- [Rowan jelly (lijsterbessengelei)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Rowan with apple, cooked and set for game.
- [Wild garlic pesto (daslookpesto)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/wild-garlic-pesto/): Wild garlic with cheese, nuts and oil.
- [Nettle soup (brandnetelsoep)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/nettle-soup/): Young nettles in a creamy potato soup.
- [Sea beet stamppot](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/sea-beet-stamppot/): Mashed potatoes stirred with wilted sea beet and smoked sausage.
- [Hazelnut cake (hazelnotentaart)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/hazelnut-cake/): Buttery cake with toasted hazelnuts.
- [Elderberry pudding (vlierbessenpudding)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/elderberry-pudding/): Cooked elderberries thickened into a dark pudding.
- [Blackberry crumble (bramencrumble)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/blackberry-crumble/): Blackberries under an oat crumble.
- [Birch sap (berkensap)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/birch-sap/): Fresh spring sap, chilled.
- [Rose hip syrup (rozenbottelsiroop)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/rose-hip-syrup/): Hips from dune roses cooked into syrup.
- [Sea purslane with butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/sea-purslane-with-butter/): Zoutmelde fried quickly in butter, beside fish.
- [Chanterelles with garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/chanterelles-with-garlic/): Cantharellen fried with garlic and parsley.
- [Rowan and apple jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/rowan-and-apple-jam/): Lijsterbes with apple, for game.
- [Pickled samphire (zeekraal)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/pickled-samphire/): Samphire in a sweet vinegar pickle.
- [Porcini risotto (eekhoorntjesbrood)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/porcini-risotto/): Creamy risotto with porcini.
- [Lamb's lettuce and bacon stamppot](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/lamb-s-lettuce-and-bacon-stamppot/): Raw veldsla stirred into hot mash with bacon.
- [Wild garlic mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/wild-garlic-mussels/): Mussels steamed with daslook and cream.
- [Elderflower pancakes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/elderflower-pancakes/): Pancakes with elderflower heads cooked into the batter.
- [Sloe gin jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/sloe-gin-jelly/): Sleedoorn gin set into a jelly.
- [Blackberry and apple pie (appeltaart)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/nl/dishes/blackberry-and-apple-pie/): Dutch lattice apple pie with blackberries.
